description.zh: 保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符。更多信息，请参见[如何保证幂等性](~~25693~~)。
description.en: A client token to ensure the idempotence of the request. The token must be unique among different requests. It can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length. For more information, see [How to ensure idempotence](~~25693~~).
The ID of the image cache.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun eci delete-image-cache --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --image-cache-id imc-2zebxkiifuyzzlhl0000 --client-token 123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426655440000 --region cn-hangzhou
